Octave version: 11.3.0

```{octave}
% Set up environment
clear all;

pkg load statistics;


% Read in data
fid = fopen('dat/Independent t-test/indttest_R_Protzko.csv', 'r');

data = textscan(fid, '%f %f', 'Delimiter', ',', 'HeaderLines', 1);

fclose(fid);

% Get columns
outcome  = data{1};
grouping = data{2};

outcome_g1 = outcome(grouping == 0);
outcome_g2 = outcome(grouping == 1);

[sig, p_value, ci, stats] = ttest2(outcome_g1, outcome_g2)
```
